title: NVDA Resets the Narrative
summary: Yesterday, we pointed out that we came into this week looking at three well-known potential market catalysts. The first, PCE, was a dud. The third, Fed Chair Warsh’s address to the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium, doesn’t occur until tomorrow. The second, however, was a doozy. Nvidia’s (NVDA) earnings report was originally greeted with a bit of a yawn. Then, during the conference call, management indicated that revenues are likely to grow by 70%, well above the 45% analyst consensus. Suddenly, the AI trade seemed much sunnier.
